info.title: EKOS API
info.description:
Generated from src/server/apiRegistry.ts — do not edit by hand; run `npm run api:spec`.

Authentication is an interim, UNSIGNED bearer id (`Authorization: Bearer <userId>`) resolved against the user roster, not a verified token. Every operation's `x-authorization` field states what the server enforces. See docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md.

bearerUserId.description: Unsigned user id. Not cryptographically verified — see the note above.
